Overview

The Security Project Manager leads the end-to-end delivery of complex information security initiatives, combining disciplined project management with sufficient technical security insight to challenge assumptions, manage dependencies and support informed decisions.
Reporting to the Head of Information Security Transformation, the role coordinates multidisciplinary teams, vendors and business stakeholders; maintains strong governance over scope, schedule, cost, risk and benefits; and facilitates the organisational change required for secure solutions to be adopted and sustained
Key Accountabilities and main responsibilities

Strategic Focus 
Lead security projects from initiation through delivery, transition and closure, establishing clear scope, objectives, milestones, dependencies, resources, budgets and measurable outcomes.
Define and track delivery, adoption and risk-reduction measures to confirm intended benefits are realised.
Build trusted relationships with sponsors, business owners, technology leaders, risk teams and operational stakeholders across multiple regions and time zones.
Provide concise, evidence-based reporting on progress, cost, risk, decisions, benefits and matters requiring executive intervention.

Operational Management 
Develop and maintain delivery plans, governance forums, status reporting, decision logs and financial controls in accordance with enterprise project delivery standards.
Facilitate technical workshops, design reviews, planning sessions and delivery stand-ups, translating complex security concepts into clear actions, decisions and stakeholder impacts.
Work closely with security architects, engineers and technology teams to validate estimates, identify technical dependencies and ensure security requirements are incorporated into delivery plans and acceptance criteria.
Manage vendors and delivery partners against agreed scope, milestones, quality, commercial commitments and remediation actions.
Maintain budget forecasts, resource plans, procurement activities and project charging information, supporting accurate cost management and recovery.
Coordinate testing, implementation, cutover, support arrangements, documentation, training and handover to operational owners.

People Leadership 
Coordinate multidisciplinary teams, vendors and business stakeholders, creating clarity on responsibilities, decisions and shared delivery outcomes.
Assess stakeholder, process and technology impacts and develop proportionate change, communication, engagement and training plans.
Facilitate adoption by engaging impacted teams early, addressing resistance, clarifying new responsibilities and tracking readiness and uptake.
Recognise when specialist technical or risk advice is required and ensure the appropriate subject-matter experts are engaged at the right stage.

Governance & Risk
Manage risks, issues, assumptions and dependencies, ensuring timely escalation, accountable ownership and transparent reporting to sponsors and governance forums.
Control scope and change requests, balancing security outcomes, delivery constraints, cost, operational readiness and business priorities.
Apply practical awareness of identity, cloud, data protection, network security, privileged access, security operations and regulatory controls to delivery planning and decision-making.
Ensure go-live criteria, control evidence, residual risks and operational acceptance are documented and approved before closure.
Capture lessons learned and improve security project templates, governance, reporting and delivery practices.

The above list of key accountabilities is not an exhaustive list and may change from time-to-time based on business needs.

Experience 
Relevant tertiary qualification in technology, cybersecurity, business or project management, or equivalent professional experience.
Minimum 8+ years of project delivery experience, including responsibility for complex cybersecurity, infrastructure, cloud, identity, data protection or technology transformation initiatives.
Demonstrated experience managing scope, schedule, budget, resources, risks, dependencies, vendors and benefits across multidisciplinary teams.
Demonstrated experience planning and facilitating business change, stakeholder communications, training, operational readiness and adoption.
Proficiency with project delivery and reporting tools such as Jira, ServiceNow, Microsoft Project, Excel, Confluence or equivalent platforms.
Project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2 or Agile delivery certification is preferred; change management certification such as Prosci is desirable.

Highly organised, accountable and comfortable managing ambiguity, competing priorities and delivery pressure.

Collaborative and outcome-focused, with a commitment to sustainable change, effective governance and continuous improvement.

new_jobs.description:
Dayforce is a global human capital management (HCM) company headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, and Minneapolis, Minnesota, with operations across North America, Europe, Middle East, Africa (EMEA), and the Asia Pacific Japan (APJ) region.

Our award-winning Cloud HCM platform offers a unified solution database and continuous calculation engine, driving efficiency, productivity and compliance for the global workforce.

Our brand promise - Makes Work Life Better™ - Reflects our commitment to employees, customers, partners and communities globally.

About The Opportunity

As a Principal Data Analyst, you are a highly analytical, technically strong, forward-thinking problem solver who thrives on turning data into strategic insight and building modern decision products. You will play a pivotal role within the Decision Intelligence team, combining deep analytical expertise with hands-on technical skills to solve complex business problems using enterprise data, business intelligence, artificial intelligence (AI), and automation.

This is a hands-on technical role with significant visibility across the organization. You will work directly with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders while personally designing and building analytical solutions - ranging from enterprise semantic models and Power BI experiences to AI-powered applications and agents. Your work will directly influence strategic decisions and help evolve how the enterprise consumes data, insights, and AI.

What You'll Get To Do

Promote Data-Driven Decision-Making: Translate ambiguous business questions into analytical solutions that go beyond stated needs - proactively surfacing insights, root causes, opportunities, and recommended actions that guide executive strategy and operational excellence.
Build Modern Decision Products: Personally design and build analytical products ranging from scalable semantic models and advanced Power BI experiences to AI-powered analytical applications and agents. Select the appropriate interface and technology based on the business problem rather than defaulting to traditional dashboards.
Build AI-Powered Analytical Solutions: Design, prototype, build, and help productionize AI-enabled analytical applications and agents that combine enterprise data, semantic context, large language models (LLMs), APIs, and tools to answer business questions, generate insights, and automate analytical workflows.
Collaborate Across the Business: Partner with leaders in designated departments and other domains to define key metrics, interpret performance results, understand business context, and connect analytics and AI solutions to financial, operational, customer, and growth objectives.
Engineer Trusted Analytical Foundations: Build and maintain reliable data models, metric definitions, semantic models, and analytical logic. Troubleshoot data gaps and partner with data engineering and governance teams to strengthen data quality, lineage, consistency, and trust.
Apply Practical AI and Automation: Identify high-value opportunities for AI and automation, then move beyond ideation to working solutions. Apply techniques such as tool/function calling, structured outputs, retrieval and grounding, context engineering, and agentic workflows where they provide measurable business value.
Evaluate for Accuracy and Reliability: Develop practical approaches to test and monitor AI-enabled analytical solutions, including grounding, hallucination and accuracy testing, regression testing, observability, and human review. Understand when deterministic analytics, traditional machine learning, or an LLM-based approach is most appropriate.
Communicate with Confidence: Synthesize complex analyses and technical solutions into clear, compelling narratives and present actionable insights, tradeoffs, and recommendations to senior leadership.

Skills And Experience We Value

Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, Economics, Business Analytics, or a related analytical field; Master's degree preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in data analytics, business intelligence, analytical engineering, data science, decision science, or related technical roles, preferably in an enterprise SaaS, technology, consulting, or complex business environment.
Strong SQL, data modeling, and analytical engineering skills, with hands-on experience building enterprise analytics solutions using platforms such as Power BI. Candidates should be comfortable working directly in Power BI when needed, including semantic models, DAX, performance optimization, advanced dashboards, and executive-facing analytical products.
Strong hands-on Python skills and comfort working with APIs, Git, JSON, testing and debugging, notebooks, and modern development workflows used to build analytical and AI-enabled solutions.
Demonstrated hands-on experience building AI/LLM applications beyond the use of AI productivity tools or commercial chat applications. Experience should include several of the following: agentic workflows, tool/function calling, structured outputs, retrieval/RAG, context engineering, prompt design, API integration, and evaluation frameworks.
Demonstrated track record of personally designing and building AI-enabled analytical products or agentic systems from prototype toward production. Candidates should be prepared to discuss architecture, implementation decisions, evaluation methods, failures, tradeoffs, and lessons learned from systems they personally built.
Strong understanding of semantic modeling, metric design, KPI frameworks, business definitions, data quality, lineage, and governance practices needed to provide trusted context to both enterprise reporting and AI-enabled analytical experiences.
Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical and technical approaches, identify root causes, quantify business impact, and determine when a problem is best solved with SQL or deterministic software, traditional analytics or machine learning, a BI experience, or an LLM/agentic solution.
Experience evaluating AI systems for accuracy, grounding, reliability, and business usefulness, including approaches such as test datasets, hallucination testing, regression testing, observability, human review, and appropriate controls for enterprise use.
Proven experience leading complex analytical or AI initiatives from concept through implementation with minimal oversight, including requirements definition, stakeholder alignment, hands-on development, testing, delivery, adoption, and ongoing optimization.
Experience partnering with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders to define success metrics, interpret performance trends, and connect analytical and AI solutions to financial, operational, customer, and growth outcomes.
Exceptional communication, analytical reasoning, and business acumen, with the ability to synthesize complex data and technical concepts into clear narratives, evaluate tradeoffs, prioritize work based on business value, and influence decisions at senior levels.
High degree of intellectual curiosity, ownership, technical judgment, and attention to detail. We value demonstrated building experience over theoretical familiarity; candidates should be prepared to discuss systems they personally designed and implemented. Experience working in the Human Capital Management industry is preferred.

What’s In It For You

Dayforce is fueled by the diversity of our talented employees. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider and embrace ALL individuals and what makes them unique. We believe our employees should be happy and healthy, with peace of mind and a sense of fulfillment.

We encourage individuals to apply based on their passions.

Dayforce encourages personal and professional growth. We offer excellent time away from work programs, comprehensive wellness initiatives and recognition through competitive pay and benefits.

With a commitment to community impact, including volunteer days and our charity, Dayforce Cares we provide opportunities for you to thrive both in your career and personal life. Our focus is not just on your job but on supporting you to be the best version of yourself.

This job posting is for an existing vacancy

Artificial intelligence may be used in the screening, assessment, or selection of applicants for this position.

About The Salary Ranges

Please note that the salary range mentioned in this job description should serve simply as a guide. The final compensation offered may vary based on a variety of factors, including bonuses and/or incentives, or a candidate’s experience, skills, budget and location. Our company is committed to providing a fair, equitable, and competitive package that reflects the value an individual brings to the organization.

new_jobs.description:
About Blue Cross And Blue Shield Of Minnesota

At Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Minnesota, we are committed to paving the way for everyone to achieve their healthiest life. We are looking for dedicated and motivated individuals who share our vision of transforming healthcare. As a Blue Cross associate, you are joining a culture that is built on values of succeeding together, finding a better way, and doing the right thing. If you are ready to make a difference, join us.

The Impact You Will Have

Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Minnesota is hiring a Program Manager, Risk Adjustment Coding and Quality. In this position, you’ll be responsible for the design, implementation, evaluation, and ongoing management of the Risk Adjustment Coding and Quality Program, supporting Medicare, Medicaid, ACA, and Commercial populations to optimize Blue Cross’s earned risk-adjusted revenue. The role serves as the subject matter expert for risk adjustment coding, partnering with leadership and cross-functional teams to develop and execute strategic initiatives, identify data trends, and implement performance improvement opportunities through collaboration with analytics and other key stakeholders. The incumbent ensures program strategies and operations meet evolving regulatory, market, provider, and member requirements while addressing complex business challenges and supporting organizational change. Acting as a liaison across multiple departments, the individual leads enterprise-wide initiatives, drives results within established timelines, and provides leadership and oversight to program management staff within the division. Working closely with the Director, this position supports the implementation of strategic initiatives, monitors project progress, and oversees team and vendor performance to ensure key objectives and deadlines are achieved. The role leads coding and audits review activities, including medical record reviews to support accurate risk adjustment revenue, compliance, audits of provider and vendor documentation to ensure accuracy and completeness, and operational readiness efforts for government audits related to risk adjustment programs.

What You’ll Do

Lead Medicare Advantage (MA) and ACA Risk Adjustment coding operations, including chart review programs, RADV and HRADV audit readiness, and coding validation activities to ensure accurate risk score capture, regulatory compliance, and revenue optimization. Expert in HCC and HHS risk adjustment methodology.
Manage and develop a team of certified coding professionals (CPCs), providing leadership, oversight, and coaching while driving coding accuracy, quality performance, and operational excellence.
Partner with providers, vendors, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver risk adjustment education, ensure vendor performance and compliance, and implement strategies that improve documentation quality and audit outcomes.

How You’ll Do It

Drive the development and documentation of design, requirements and implementation required to support initiatives that align with strategic priorities.
Develop relationships and partner with key resources, both internal and external, to collaborate on the design and ensure all market, member, and provider considerations are factored into the design.
Drive business decision making process to ensure capabilities, systems and processes meet market expectations and that alternate approaches are vetted and explored.
Manage related ongoing program management work to understand what is needed to recommend strategy and solutions, while influencing and steering others to accomplish that strategy across multiple complex programs.
Ensure that appropriate metrics are chosen and that the appropriate measurement, data analysis and evaluation occur for each initiative.
Develop and continually update program or project plans, timelines and deliverables while coordinating multiple sub-processes to expand and/or improve complex programs.
Develop and implement a communication plan in conjunction with leadership and to support initiatives, including status and progress updates.
Stay abreast of changes in the rapidly evolving health care marketplace and in regulatory or quality‑measurement programs.
Performs additional responsibilities consistent with the scope and level of the role, as assigned.

Required Skills & Experience

5+ years of progressive project/program management experience, with 1+ staff, team lead or project lead experience.
Bachelor’s degree; in lieu of a degree, an additional two years of relevant experience beyond the qualifications listed above may be accepted.

Preferred Skills & Experience

Strong knowledge of CMS risk adjustment models (ACA and Medicare Advantage).
Experience with HCC coding, RADV audits, and/or chart review programs preferred.
CPC, CCS or CRC coding certification strongly preferred.
Experience developing or supporting provider education or training initiatives preferred.
Masters degree in related field.
Ability to communicate expectations and priorities clearly to team members, actively listen to resolve issues and remove barriers, and drive alignment across teams and stakeholders.
Ability to analyze department challenges, guide team decision-making, and collaborate across teams to drive resolution and next steps.
Ability to effectively organize team work, balance priorities across projects, and manage time and resources to ensure timely delivery and coordination.
Healthcare or managed care experience.
Experience managing complex projects which may involve multiple team members, task assignment, working with internal or external clients, managing teams and customer relationships, and managing project deliverables.
Experience in data-driven decision-making.
Process improvement (Lean / Six Sigma) experience.
Familiarity with PM tools & Microsoft analytics tools.

Role Designation

Hybrid

Anchored in Connection

Our hybrid approach is designed to balance flexibility with meaningful in-person connection and collaboration. We come together in the office two days each week – most teams designate at least one anchor day to ensure team interaction. These in-person moments foster relationships, creativity, and alignment. The rest of the week you are empowered to work remote.

Compensation And Benefits

Pay Range:
$102,400.00 - $138,300.00 - $174,200.00 Annual

Pay is based on several factors which vary based on position, including skills, ability, and knowledge the selected individual is bringing to the specific job.

Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Life insurance
401k
Paid Time Off (PTO)
Volunteer Paid Time Off (VPTO)
And more

Demonstrate ability to explore and quickly grasp new technologies to progress varied initiatives

Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Advanced Data Analyst, Experimentation Lead - FC Ultimate Team

As one of the largest sports entertainment platforms in the world, EA SPORTS FC is redefining football with genre-leading interactive experiences, connecting a global community of fans to The World's Game through innovation and unrivaled authenticity.

With more opportunity than ever to design, innovate and create new, immersive experiences that bring joy, inclusivity, and connection to fans everywhere, we invite you to join our passionate and dynamic team as we pioneer the future of football fandom.

The FC Data & Analytics team is seeking an Advanced Data Analyst to join our Ultimate Team (UT) function. Reporting to a Senior Manager, you will lead the Experimentation program for FC Premium Analytics. You’ll also collaborate closely with data, production, and product management partners to drive informed decision-making within a dynamic live service environment.

We are looking for a candidate who is excited at the prospect of cultivating and uncovering actionable insights from live player data and contributing to the sustained success of one of the industry's most prominent live service products. In this role, you will act as a data leader, driving design, implementation, and evaluation of numerous player-facing experiments.

What You'll Do On Our Team

Collaborate with production teams to define telemetry requirements, ensuring robust data collection and validity.
Design and implement player-facing experimentation using best practices in a complex, live environment
Write and maintain complex SQL and scripting workflows to extract, transform, and validate large-scale telemetry datasets
Build and maintain scalable dashboards that translate complex datasets into clear, actionable business insights for cross-functional partners
Explore user behavioral patterns through experimentation to identify opportunities for improving player experiences and to inform live content release strategies
Present analytical findings clearly and effectively to stakeholders of all seniority levels to facilitate informed decision-making
Act as a subject-matter expert in all things experimentation, helping to drive adoption of a data-driven, test-and-learn focused culture across FC’s development team

What We're Looking For

Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Operations Research) or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of technical experience in data analytics, with a focus on performing quantitative analysis with large datasets to guide decision-making
Expert knowledge or equivalent practical experience in leading an experimentation function for a live product
Proficiency in SQL with the ability to extract data from complex, multi-source systems.
Hands-on experience with data visualization software (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
Strong programming skills (e.g., Python, R) with experience writing scripts for data transformation and statistical analysis
Passion for gaming or previous experience in the gaming industry is considered a strong plus.

For Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of sick time, paid top-up to EI/QPIP benefits up to 100% of base salary when you welcome a new child (12 weeks for maternity, and 4 weeks for parental/adoption leave), extended health/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, disability insurance, retirement plan to regular full-time employees. We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. new_jobs.title: Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
📍 Oslo / Bergen / Bodø

💰 Salary: 800 000 - 1 000 000 NOK/year

🌍 Why this role matters

Aidn has become the market leader in the municipal healthcare sector in Norway, and municipalities across the country are now being onboarded to our platform. That gives us something few companies have: the chance to change how an entire sector understands and uses its own data.

Today, most municipalities lack accessible, trustworthy insight into their own operational and clinical data. At the same time, they are facing an aging population that will put more pressure on their services every year. Good decisions will matter more than ever, and good decisions need good data.

Aidn Analytics is core to what we offer, but we are still early in defining what it will become. Whoever takes this role will help shape it from the ground up, at a time when AI is changing what insight work even looks like.

🔧 What You’ll Be Working On

As our Data Analyst, you will help Aidn and the municipalities make better decisions. You will build data products as part of your everyday work, and at the same time help set the standard for how data products get built across Aidn.

Your core responsibilities will include:

Building and maintaining analytics: Build the reports, dashboards, self-service tools, and data exports that municipalities and teams at Aidn rely on every day, with conversational analytics as an emerging capability.
Define what we measure: Defining metrics and balanced quality and performance indicators for the municipalities as well as for Aidn internally.
Working with municipalities: Working directly with municipal leadership and staff to translate operational and strategic questions into data products, and following up until those products are actually used.
Strengthening data literacy: both at Aidn and in the municipalities, by developing capabilities and training that enable users to be self-served and create value from our data products.
Setting the standard for how data products get built, including improving the developer experience supported by AI. Enabling others to build according to our best practices.
Supporting product teams and helping them move towards distributed data ownership where they create data products within their domain for internal and external purposes
Contributing to platform work, tooling adoption and the shared developer experience for insights work, and embedding in product teams when they need hands-on support

🤝Who You Are

We hire for attitude as much as for aptitude. Curiosity, ownership, and a collaborative spirit matter more than ticking every box.

That said, you’ll thrive here if you:

3+ years of experience in a data analyst role or similar, with an analytical mindset and a good understanding of what it takes to succeed with analytics.
A strong analytical mindset, turning vague questions into answers that change decisions. You ask good questions and work in a structured way with data, while thinking creatively and pragmatically about how we meet user needs. This is one of the most important qualities we’re looking for.
Write SQL independently at an advanced level, and have experience with modern data platforms (such as Databricks or Snowflake) and related tooling (such as dbt).
Are comfortable at both ends of the data value chain: you can bring in and model a new data source yourself, and you can also run a session with non-technical stakeholders to help them use and understand the data
You actively use AI in your analytics work today, and are curious about how AI, automation and new ways of working can raise the quality, speed and impact of what we deliver with data.
Have excellent communication skills, and have experience working with non-technical users and translating their needs, questions, and problems into data products
Experience from a product organisation, working in cross-functional teams where data products are built, shipped, and continuously improved.
Have built data products that people actually use in decision-making, and improved them over time.
A delivery-oriented, pragmatic approach, and the ability to take ownership and work independently in an ambiguous, fast-changing environment.
Fluent Norwegian (C1 level) for collaboration and testing with municipal users, and professional English for internal collaboration.

Our analytics stack is built on Databricks, dbt, and Metabase. Experience with dbt or a similar transformation tool is a plus, as is experience with a self-service reporting tool, some Python, Amplitude, or a background in healthtech, the public sector, or another regulated data environment. None of these are dealbreakers.

👋
The Team

You will join our Data & Analytics team, a cross-functional team established in 2026 with a data engineer, a UX designer, two developers (including a tech lead) and a product manager. The team owns the shared data platform, the analytics capabilities and the overall Aidn Analytics experience. We aim for domain teams to own their analytical content; we own the platform, the governance and the holistic experience for anyone using or building analytics.

The team operates as its own product area and works closely with several product teams and our Infrastructure team.

Problems we’re working on right now include:

How do we build a modern data platform from a blank slate, with no legacy to migrate away from, in a way that will genuinely serve Aidn and the municipalities for years to come?
How do we help municipal care leaders move towards insight-based decisions, at both the strategic and operational levels, before the aging population wave hits?
How can AI and agents make data more accessible and understandable, both internally at Aidn and directly for municipal users?
How do we onboard many of Norway’s municipalities and shape a shared direction for Aidn Analytics together with them?

💬 What Success Looks Like

After 3 months:

Ramped up on Aidn’s domain and data model, and has met key municipal users and product teams.
Has delivered a few data products end-to-end, working with increasing independence.
The first data products are in real use by real customers.

After 6 months:

Owns reporting and analysis for a defined product or domain area.
Known and trusted by power users in the municipalities, and the natural point of contact at Aidn for data products and insights in that area.
Helps the team drive adoption of our data tooling.

After 12 months:

Spots opportunities in the data and across Aidn, rather than just responding to requests.
Has helped shape how the team defines and tracks success metrics, with a visible change in Aidn’s maturity as a data-driven organisation.
Has made a visible contribution to municipalities’ adoption of self-service analytics.

💙 Why you’ll love working here

High trust, real ownership. You’ll join a team with the freedom to explore challenging problems and own the results.
Visible impact. Your work will directly affect how healthcare professionals and municipalities across Norway do their jobs every day.
No legacy. You'll join a newly established team with no legacy, and the freedom to build great Data and Analytics experiences for our product teams and municipalities.
AI as a core tool. You'll actively incorporate AI into your work — experimenting with agentic tools, automating parts of your workflow, and helping define what responsible AI use looks like in Data & Analytics.

🎁 Perks And Benefits

6 weeks vacation
Flexible working hours and location
Health & wellness benefit
Employee shares
Pension, insurance, and full pay during parental leave
A collaborative, ambitious, and caring team.

👀 Interested?

We don't ask for cover letters. Just upload your CV or share your LinkedIn profile, and tell us what sparked your interest in the role.

We value diverse perspectives and would love to hear what you could bring to the Data & Analytics team. We can’t wait to see your application!

👉 Application deadline: November 8th, 2026

Kernel cooperation

With financial backing in order, we are privileged to be a fully autonomous startup busy building our company from the ground up the way we see fit.

The Market & Business Analyst, Corporate Strategy is a foundational role within the Strategy, Marketing, and Communications function. Reporting to the Executive Director of Strategy, Marketing & Communications, this analyst will provide data, insights, and recommendations that support enterprise strategy and the company’s long-term vision. The role combines market and competitive intelligence, business analytics, financial modeling, and trend forecasting to inform marketing, business development, innovation, and leadership decisions.

The analyst will contribute to annual and three-year planning by using macro- and micro-level analysis to assess growth opportunities and strategic initiatives. Job Title:

The Computer Science Teachers Association (CSTA) is a membership organization that supports and promotes the teaching of computer science, providing opportunities for PK-12 teachers and their students to better understand computer science and to more successfully prepare themselves to teach and learn. 

CSTA is looking for an experienced Project Manager who will lead the implementation of the Cross Subject AI Collaborative, a national effort to bring computer science and other disciplines together to define and teach AI literacy across PK–12 education
. The Project Manager will coordinate convenings of national subject-area associations, manage the development of interdisciplinary instructional resources with CS and non-CS educators, guide dissemination and professional development aligned to these resources, and work with contractors and external reviewers to ensure all project deliverables are met, and advocate for adoption of the project's outputs across the education community. 
Project Description AI literacy can't be the responsibility of computer science alone. Students encounter AI in every subject, and each discipline has a distinct role in helping them understand, use, and critically evaluate it. The purpose of the Collaborative is to define that shared responsibility and give educators the tools to act on it.
CSTA is convening national subject-area associations, including those representing mathematics, English language arts, science, world languages, and technology and engineering into a cross-subject collaborative. Through three convenings, the collaborative will produce an interdisciplinary AI Literacies Framework and a Division-of-Labor Map describing how responsibility for AI literacy is distributed across subject areas. Both will be publicly launched at the CSTA Annual Conference in July 2027.
Alongside this work, the Collaborative brings CS and non-CS educators together in collaborative workshops to develop, classroom-test, and refine interdisciplinary instructional resources that integrate foundational AI concepts with subjects such as math, ELA, and social studies. The resources are aligned to the 2026 CSTA PK–12 Computer Science Standards and other disciplinary standards. Together, these efforts will shape how AI literacy is taught across disciplines in schools nationwide.

of developed resources.

and other contractors

new_jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Fauna
new_jobs.description:
Description

Fauna Robotics is looking for a Technical Program Manager to own quality for robot behavior and data collection. You will write and maintain the test suite that every release and every new policy goes through. That suite has two layers. The first is a core set of regression tests that confirms, every time, that the robot's locomotion, manipulation, mode transitions, and autonomy hand-offs still behave as expected. The second, and harder, layer goes looking for the subtle problems a routine pass will miss: failures that appear only in particular sequences of events, under particular loads, or in the interaction between the operator, the teleoperation stack, and the robot. You will run these tests yourself on experimental hardware, write clear and reproducible reports, and work with the engineering teams until each issue is understood and resolved.

You will also help keep the data we collect at a high quality through hands-on, on-site work with the robots: supporting benchmark collections, reviewing recorded episodes, and tracking data problems back to their root cause, whether that's the operator, the teleoperation stack, the robot, or the pipeline. As new collection tasks come out of research, you'll pilot them on hardware with the data scientists who designed them, validate the tools and methods they depend on, and say whether they're ready to run at scale. You'll be the go-to person for bringing new data collectors and QA team members up to speed on our teleoperation stack, our data collection management and ingestion tools, and the basics of finding, triaging, and reporting bugs.

Key job responsibilities

Own the release test suite for robot behavior and teleoperation. Write, maintain, and run test plans for updates to the teleoperation stack, internal and external software releases, and new robot policies.
Maintain a repeatable core regression suite that every change must pass, and extend it with deeper, adversarial test cases designed to surface subtle, intermittent, or interaction-dependent failures across the operator, the teleoperation stack, and the robot.
Run tests hands-on with experimental robots and in simulation. Write detailed, reproducible test reports and bug reports, and give clear go/no-go recommendations for each release and each new policy.
Track issues through to resolution with software, controls, hardware, and ML teams. Keep a record of known issues, how to reproduce them, and workarounds.
Support data quality through hands-on, on-robot testing: help run benchmark collections, review recordings against task requirements, flag problem episodes, and feed the failure patterns you find back to the teams that own the process and tooling.
Pilot new data collection tasks alongside data scientists and research engineers: translate research intent into an executable protocol, run the first sessions yourself, and report back on feasibility, throughput, and data quality.
Validate the data collection tools and methods behind each task before they're relied on at scale — define acceptance criteria, quantify failure modes, and make the go/no-go call. Iterate on task setups, scene design, and annotation schemas where the data doesn't hold up.
Onboard and mentor new data collectors and QA team members on our teleoperation stack, the data collection management system, the ingestion and annotation tools, and how to report bugs well.
Coordinate the day-to-day test and benchmark activities that data collectors take part in. Work with the data collection program manager, who owns the data collectors' work and priorities, to schedule robot time, sessions, and test coverage.
Assess the spaces and resources that testing and collection depend on — lab and home-like environments, robot availability, headsets and peripherals, fixtures and props — and flag what's missing before it becomes a bottleneck.

Keep test documentation, checklists, SOPs, and run books up to date as the robot, the app, and our policies change.

Work safely around experimental hardware, and hold the people you train to the same standard.

About The Team

Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.

We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.

Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.

At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.

If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we’re interested in hearing from you.

Basic Qualifications

3+ years of technical product or program management experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
3+ years of experience in quality assurance, test, or validation of hardware or hardware-plus-software products (robotics, consumer electronics, automotive, aerospace, XR, or similar), or in technical program management for such products
Experience writing and running structured test plans and SOPs, and producing detailed, reproducible test and bug reports with logs, timestamps, media, and system context
Experience working hands-on with physical robots or other experimental hardware in a lab or test environment, including diagnosing failures that span hardware, firmware, and software
Experience teleoperating robots, or extensive hands-on use of VR/XR headsets
Linux and command-line proficiency — able to run scripts and terminal tooling to drive, inspect, and debug hardware directly
Able to work in a VR headset for extended sessions (multiple hours at a time) and to work safely around experimental robots, which includes standing, moving, and occasionally lifting equipment
Able to lift up to 10 lbs and wear equipment weighing up to 30 lbs; continuous hand/eye coordination, fine manipulation, and kinesthetic awareness
Experience training, onboarding, or mentoring others on technical tools or processes
Ability to write technical documentation precise enough for an operator or support agent to follow without the author present

Preferred Qualifications

3+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
Experience teleoperating robots with a Meta Quest 3 (or a similar VR teleoperation setup)
Experience with robot learning data collection, such as demonstration data, episode annotation, or dataset quality review
Experience validating robot control or learned policies on hardware before release
Experience leading QA across a hardware, firmware, and software product ecosystem, including fleet-level validation testing and catching performance regressions before release
Python scripting for hardware control; firmware flashing and diagnostic interfaces; electromechanical diagnostics (motors, sensors, thermal systems)
Experience using LLMs or AI coding tools to build simple internal tools such as dashboards, web UIs, or report generators to speed up QA work
Familiarity with issue trackers and test management tools, and with reading logs or telemetry to narrow down a failure
Experience coordinating the daily work of operators or test technicians without being their direct manager
Experience owning production incidents or executive escalations end-to-end in unfamiliar system architecture
Experience running observational research or usability studies and translating interaction data into product direction
Background in robotics, HRI, data operations, or games
